# Idea Emergence

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The process of how ideas you encounter go from "nothingness to somethingness", and how they grow in richness, complexity, and meaning over time.

## Scope note

- Process and methodology recommended by Nick Milo and Linking Your Thinking (LYT) for linked note systems like Obsidian.

## Broader

- [Ideaverse](../Ideaverse/)
